{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegetables|Vegetable recipes]] | [[Cookbook:North American cuisines|North American cuisines]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|United States cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Cajun cuisine|Cajun cuisine]]

'''Smothered okra''' is an easy dish that works well as a side vegetable. It can also be added to seafood and okra [[Cookbook:Gumbo|gumbo]] as the okra base. It is made with [[Cookbook:Okra|okra]] and [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], and is best served over [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]].

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Okra|okra]], washed
* 4–5 medium [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* ½ medium-large yellow [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], diced 
* 2–3 stalks [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] or diced 
* 1 green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]], diced 
* 2–3 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], sliced or diced
* 1 stick (½ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] / 113 g) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]], to taste

==Procedure==
# Remove okra tips and heads, and slice into ¼–½ inch wide pieces.
# [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] onion, celery, and bell pepper in butter until soft over medium heat, adding garlic to sauté shortly before the onion is soft.
# Add okra and tomatoes. Stir a few times to incorporate. If the mixture seems a bit dry, add a small amount of water. 
# [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] over medium heat until the okra is no longer sticky and stringy. The okra will change to a darker green color.
# Serve over rice or freeze to use in your next gumbo.
